channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling possible rate hike
item.description: After confusing markets at his July news conference, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh used Jackson Hole to give a clearer view of the case for higher interest rates.

item.title: Trump loses bid to transfer New York hush money case to federal court
item.description: Trump's conviction in the hush money case relates to conduct that preceded the 2016 presidential election, which led to his first term in the White House.

item.title: Apple hikes subscription prices for Apple TV and Apple One in the U.S.
item.description: Apple raised prices for Apple Music by $1 per month in July, citing licensing costs.

item.title: S&P 500 falls, but heads for winning week as Warsh says Fed committed to fighting inflation: Live updates
item.description: With Thursday's advance, the three major indexes are on track to end the week higher.

item.title: Treasury moves to sanction UAE branch of Egyptian bank over Iran ties
item.description: Banque Misr UAE processed about $1.8 billion over two years for some 100 companies that are potentially part of Iran's shadow banking network, Treasury said.

item.title: Oil exports from the Gulf rise to more than 60% of level before Iran war, Goldman Sachs estimates
item.description: It has become difficult to figure out how much oil is flowing from the Gulf because information from the region is limited due to the war, Goldman said.

item.title: Iran calls for global pushback against U.S. sanctions, says diplomacy 'isn't impossible'
item.description: Iran said the conflict in the Gaza Strip has to end, Israel has to withdraw from Lebanon and also halt its attacks on Syria.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Amazon, Marvell, PayPal, Salesforce & more
item.description: Here are some of the companies making headlines in midday trading.

item.title: 2-year Treasury yield jumps as Warsh says Fed may 'have work to do'
item.description: Investors assessed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish message in his keynote address at Jackson Hole.

item.title: Walmart settles U.S. government's opioid lawsuit
item.description: In a 2020 complaint, the Justice Department accused Arkansas-based Walmart of repeatedly violating the federal Controlled Substances Act since 2013.

item.title: How Taylor Farms became integral to America's food supply system
item.description: Taylor Farms and other suppliers have become larger and more integral to the U.S. food system, complicating foodborne illnesses such as cyclosporiasis.

item.title: Imax says it's open to a sale. Why is no one buying?
item.description: Imax's stock and box office are breaking records, but studio conflicts and a soaring valuation complicate the list of who could bid for the company.

item.title: Affirm surges on strong outlook; CEO says high gas prices are hitting U.S. shoppers
item.description: The national average price for gas is at $4.09 per gallon and was last below $3 on March 2.

item.title: Marvell shares tumble 6% as outlook underwhelms despite 37% revenue growth
item.description: Marvell Technology shares fell Friday despite a second-quarter revenue beat, as its fiscal 2028 outlook failed to meet investors' expectations.

item.title: U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports as Trump administration shifts to economic warfare
item.description: The U.S. has shifted to a campaign of economic warfare, after a dozen waves of airstrikes in July failed to force Tehran to abandon its claim to Hormuz.

item.title: 'Grand Theft Auto 6' preview signals blockbuster demand, analysts say
item.description: Take-Two shares moved higher in premarket Friday, as analysts said they were bullish on the GTA maker's parent company following a successful trailer launch.

item.title: Stocks are entering a tough period. Top small-cap strategist says buy these steady quality names
item.description: Jefferies pointed to Citizens Financial Group, Okta and McCormick & Company as good plays during a tumultuous time for the overall market.

item.title: Top tech analyst says people are buying more things on Amazon because of AI. He raised his price outlook as a result
item.description: Amazon.com could rally as wider AI adoption drives up sales on its online shopping platform, per Evercore ISI.

item.title: Marc Benioff is getting his mojo back as Salesforce's AI strength quiets skeptics
item.description: Salesforce's stock had its second-best day on record following earnings, as Wall Street shows renewed confidence in CEO Marc Benioff's AI story.

item.title: Labor Department to propose expansion of association health plans, which could lower insurance costs for some workers
item.description: The agency has submitted a rule proposal to the White House that could allow more workers to get health insurance through association health plans.

item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: 52% of Gen Z investors have redirected investing money to sports bets
